Title: GLP-1 side effects: what's common, what's serious
Summary: Common and serious side effects of semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide and orforglipron, and when to call a doctor.
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Guide
# GLP-1 side effects: what's common, what's serious

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
Common and serious side effects of semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide and orforglipron, and when to call a doctor.

Key point
Most side effects are digestive and appear when starting or increasing the dose: nausea, diarrhea, vomiting, constipation and stomach pain. Slow dose increases are designed to limit them.

## Get medical help for

- Severe stomach pain that does not go away, with or without vomiting (possible pancreatitis)
- Pain in the upper right abdomen, fever, yellow skin or eyes (gallbladder)
- Signs of dehydration or reduced urine
- A lump or swelling in the neck, hoarseness, trouble swallowing
- Signs of a serious allergic reaction

Tell any surgical or endoscopy team that you take a GLP-1 medicine, because of the risk of aspiration under anesthesia.

# New GLP-1 drugs coming: the 2026–2027 pipeline

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
CagriSema, retatrutide and other upcoming obesity and diabetes drugs: status, results and expected decisions.

Key point
None of the investigational products is legally sold. Anything marketed as one online is unapproved.

- **CagriSema** (Novo Nordisk): filed with the FDA December 2025; decision expected Q4 2026.

- **Retatrutide** (Lilly): triple agonist; FDA submission planned for Q1 2027 after positive phase 3 results.

- **Ozempic tablets 25 mg**: under FDA review, decision expected by end of 2026.

- **Survodutide** (Boehringer Ingelheim / Zealand Pharma) and other agents remain in development.

# Semaglutide — the complete guide

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
Semaglutide explained: Ozempic, Wegovy, Wegovy HD, Wegovy pill and Ozempic tablets — uses, doses, side effects, generics and cost in the US and Canada.

In short
Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist made by Novo Nordisk. It mimics a gut hormone that raises insulin release after meals, lowers glucagon, slows stomach emptying and reduces appetite.

## Semaglutide brands

| Brand | Form | Approved for (US) |

| Ozempic | Weekly injection, 0.25–2 mg | Type 2 diabetes; heart and kidney risk reduction |

| Ozempic tablets (formerly Rybelsus) | Daily tablet, 1.5/4/9 mg | Type 2 diabetes |

| Wegovy / Wegovy HD | Weekly injection, up to 2.4 mg or 7.2 mg | Weight management; heart risk; MASH |

| Wegovy pill | Daily tablet, up to 25 mg | Weight management |

## Is there generic semaglutide?

In Canada, yes — Health Canada authorized generics in April, May and June 2026. In the US, no FDA-approved generic exists; key patents run into the early 2030s. Compounded and "research" semaglutide are not approved products.

## How long does semaglutide stay in your body?

Its half-life is about one week, so it takes roughly five weeks after the last weekly dose to leave the body.

## Medicines in this group

Title: Tirzepatide: Mounjaro and Zepbound explained (2026)

Topic
# Tirzepatide — Mounjaro and Zepbound

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
Tirzepatide (Mounjaro, Zepbound): how the dual GIP/GLP-1 drug works, doses, results, side effects, vials vs pens and cost.

In short
Tirzepatide, made by Eli Lilly, activates two gut-hormone receptors — GIP and GLP-1. It is sold as [Mounjaro](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/mounjaro/) for type 2 diabetes and [Zepbound](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/zepbound/) for weight management and obstructive sleep apnea in the US.

## Doses

Both start at 2.5 mg weekly for 4 weeks, rise to 5 mg, then by 2.5 mg steps every 4 weeks or more, up to 15 mg weekly.

## Tirzepatide vs semaglutide

In head-to-head research tirzepatide produced more average weight loss than semaglutide 2.4 mg. See [Wegovy vs Zepbound](https://www.glpatlas.com/compare/wegovy-vs-zepbound/).

## Birth control

Tirzepatide can make oral contraceptives less effective. The label advises switching to a non-oral method or adding a barrier method for 4 weeks after starting and for 4 weeks after each dose increase.

## Medicines in this group

[GLP-1 & incretin medicinesMounjarotirzepatide · Once weekly](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/mounjaro/)[GLP-1 & incretin medicinesZepboundtirzepatide · Once weekly](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/zepbound/)[PipelineRetatrutide (investigational)retatrutide · Once weekly](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/retatrutide/)

Topic
# Diabetes injections — every option

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
Complete list of diabetes injections in 2026: GLP-1s (Ozempic, Mounjaro, Trulicity, Victoza), insulins (Lantus, Humalog, Tresiba, Awiqli), combinations and glucagon.

In short
Weekly: [Ozempic](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/ozempic/), [Mounjaro](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/mounjaro/), [Trulicity](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/trulicity/), Bydureon BCise. Daily: [Victoza / liraglutide](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/victoza/). These lower blood sugar and often body weight, with low risk of hypoglycemia on their own.
## Non-insulin injections (GLP-1 and dual agonists)

## Insulins

Basal (long-acting): [glargine](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/insulin-glargine/), [degludec](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/insulin-degludec/), and the once-weekly [Awiqli](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/insulin-icodec/). Mealtime: [lispro](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/insulin-lispro/), [aspart](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/insulin-aspart/), [glulisine](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/insulin-glulisine/). Human insulins: [regular](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/regular-insulin/), [NPH](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/nph-insulin/), [premixed](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/premixed-insulin/).

## Combinations

[Soliqua](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/soliqua/) (glargine + lixisenatide) and [Xultophy](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/xultophy/) (degludec + liraglutide).

## Other

[Symlin](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/symlin/) (pramlintide) with mealtime insulin, and [glucagon](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/glucagon/) for emergencies.

Title: Weight loss injections and pills approved in 2026
Summary: Every FDA-approved weight loss injection and GLP-1 pill in 2026: Wegovy, Wegovy HD, Zepbound, Saxenda, Wegovy pill and Foundayo — results, doses and cost.
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Topic
# Weight loss injections and pills

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
Every FDA-approved weight loss injection and GLP-1 pill in 2026: Wegovy, Wegovy HD, Zepbound, Saxenda, Wegovy pill and Foundayo — results, doses and cost.

In short
Ozempic and Mounjaro are diabetes brands; prescribing them for weight loss is off-label. CagriSema and retatrutide are not approved.
| Medicine | Type | How often |

| Zepbound | Tirzepatide injection | Weekly |

| Wegovy / Wegovy HD | Semaglutide injection | Weekly |

| Saxenda (generic available) | Liraglutide injection | Daily |

| Wegovy pill | Oral semaglutide | Daily, fasting |

| Foundayo | Orforglipron tablet | Daily, any time |

## Who qualifies?

US labels cover adults with a BMI of 30 or more, or 27 or more with a weight-related condition such as high blood pressure, type 2 diabetes or high cholesterol. Some products are also approved for adolescents.

# Insulin — types, brands and how they differ

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
All insulin types explained: rapid, short, intermediate, long-acting, once-weekly and premixed — brands, timing, storage and $35 cost programs.

In short
Never switch insulin type, brand or concentration without your prescriber.
| Type | Examples | Role |

| Rapid-acting | Humalog, Admelog, Lyumjev, NovoLog, Fiasp, Apidra | Mealtime |

| Short-acting | Humulin R, Novolin R | Mealtime |

| Intermediate | Humulin N, Novolin N | Basal |

| Long-acting | Lantus, Basaglar, Semglee, Rezvoglar, Toujeo, Tresiba | Basal, daily |

| Once-weekly | Awiqli (US approval March 2026) | Basal, weekly |

| Premixed | Humalog Mix 75/25, NovoLog Mix 70/30, 70/30 | Basal + mealtime |

Title: What if I miss an Ozempic dose?
Summary: Take it as soon as possible within 5 days of the missed dose. If more than 5 days have passed, skip it and take the next dose on your usual day. Never…

Question
# What if I miss an Ozempic dose?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
Take it as soon as possible within 5 days of the missed dose. If more than 5 days have passed, skip it and take the next dose on your usual day. Never take two doses to catch up.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Title: What if I miss a Wegovy dose?
Summary: If the next scheduled dose is more than 2 days away, take the missed dose as soon as possible. If it is less than 2 days away, skip it. If you miss more…
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Question
# What if I miss a Wegovy dose?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
If the next scheduled dose is more than 2 days away, take the missed dose as soon as possible. If it is less than 2 days away, skip it. If you miss more than 2 weeks, contact your prescriber — you may need to restart at a lower dose.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Question
# What if I miss a Trulicity dose?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Title: Can you drink alcohol on Ozempic, Wegovy or Zepbound?
Summary: The labels do not ban alcohol, but alcohol can worsen nausea and, with insulin or sulfonylureas, raise the risk of low blood sugar. Heavy drinking also…
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Question
# Can you drink alcohol on Ozempic, Wegovy or Zepbound?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
The labels do not ban alcohol, but alcohol can worsen nausea and, with insulin or sulfonylureas, raise the risk of low blood sugar. Heavy drinking also raises pancreatitis risk. Ask your prescriber what is safe for you.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Title: How long does semaglutide stay in your system?
Summary: Semaglutide has a half-life of about one week, so it takes about five weeks after the last weekly injection to leave the body. Effects on appetite fade…
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Question
# How long does semaglutide stay in your system?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
Semaglutide has a half-life of about one week, so it takes about five weeks after the last weekly injection to leave the body. Effects on appetite fade over that period.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Question
# What is 'Ozempic face'?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
A popular term for a hollow or aged facial look after rapid weight loss. It is caused by loss of facial fat, not by a direct effect of the drug, and can happen with any large weight loss.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Title: Does Wegovy or Zepbound cause hair loss?

Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Question
# Does Wegovy or Zepbound cause hair loss?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
Hair loss was reported more often than with placebo in weight-loss trials, mostly in people who lost a lot of weight quickly. It is usually temporary shedding linked to rapid weight loss.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Title: What happens when you stop Wegovy or Zepbound?
Summary: Appetite returns over a few weeks and most people regain a large share of lost weight within a year, as shown in withdrawal studies. Blood sugar may rise…
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Question
# What happens when you stop Wegovy or Zepbound?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
Appetite returns over a few weeks and most people regain a large share of lost weight within a year, as shown in withdrawal studies. Blood sugar may rise in people with diabetes. Plan any stop with your prescriber.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Title: Can You Take Ozempic or Wegovy While Pregnant?
Summary: No. Semaglutide should be stopped at least 2 months before a planned pregnancy because of its long half-life. Tirzepatide can reduce oral contraceptive…
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Question
# Can you take Ozempic or Wegovy while pregnant or trying to conceive?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
No. Semaglutide should be stopped at least 2 months before a planned pregnancy because of its long half-life. Tirzepatide can reduce oral contraceptive effectiveness. Talk to your prescriber before trying to conceive.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Question
# Where do you inject Ozempic, Wegovy or Zepbound?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Question
# How to manage nausea and constipation on GLP-1 medicines

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
Eat smaller meals, stop when full, avoid greasy or very sweet foods, drink fluids and increase fibre gradually. Persistent vomiting, severe pain or signs of dehydration need medical attention.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Title: What is a GLP-1 agonist?
Summary: A medicine that mimics glucagon-like peptide-1, a gut hormone released after eating. GLP-1 agonists raise insulin when blood sugar is high, lower…
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Question
# What is a GLP-1 agonist?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
A medicine that mimics glucagon-like peptide-1, a gut hormone released after eating. GLP-1 agonists raise insulin when blood sugar is high, lower glucagon, slow stomach emptying and reduce appetite. Examples: semaglutide, liraglutide, dulaglutide; tirzepatide also acts on GIP.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Title: Semaglutide vs tirzepatide: which is stronger?
Summary: Tirzepatide (Zepbound, Mounjaro) produced more average weight loss than semaglutide 2.4 mg (Wegovy) in head-to-head research. Semaglutide has more labeled…
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Question
# Semaglutide vs tirzepatide: which is stronger?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
Tirzepatide (Zepbound, Mounjaro) produced more average weight loss than semaglutide 2.4 mg (Wegovy) in head-to-head research. Semaglutide has more labeled outcome indications (heart, kidney, MASH). Wegovy HD 7.2 mg narrows the gap.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Question
# Can Ozempic be prescribed for weight loss?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer

General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Question
# When will generic semaglutide be available in the US?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Question
# Generic Ozempic in Canada: what to know

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
Health Canada authorized generic semaglutide from Dr. Reddy's (April 28, 2026) and Apotex (May 1, 2026) for type 2 diabetes, and the first generic for weight management on June 29, 2026. Ask your pharmacist about substitution under your plan.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Summary: Buy only from licensed pharmacies, check that the label, lot number and expiry are intact and match the box, and report anything unusual. Pens sold…
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Question
# How to spot fake Ozempic or Wegovy pens

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
Buy only from licensed pharmacies, check that the label, lot number and expiry are intact and match the box, and report anything unusual. Pens sold without a prescription, through social media or WhatsApp, or labeled for another country are red flags. Report suspected fakes to FDA MedWatch or Health Canada.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Title: Is compounded semaglutide legal?
Summary: Compounded drugs are not FDA-approved. Since the FDA removed semaglutide and tirzepatide from its shortage list, routine copying of the approved products…
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Question
# Is compounded semaglutide legal?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
Compounded drugs are not FDA-approved. Since the FDA removed semaglutide and tirzepatide from its shortage list, routine copying of the approved products by compounders is restricted, and the FDA has issued warning letters to sellers. 'Research use only' products are not for human use.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Question
# How long does it take for Wegovy or Zepbound to work?

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
Appetite often changes within the first weeks, but the starting doses are for tolerance, not full effect. Most weight loss happens over months as the dose rises; trials measured results at about 68–72 weeks.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Question
# What to eat on GLP-1 medicines

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
Prioritise protein, vegetables, whole grains and fluids; eat small portions slowly. Limit fried, fatty and very sugary foods, which often worsen nausea. A dietitian can help protect muscle during weight loss.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Title: How to store and travel with GLP-1 pens
Summary: Keep unopened pens refrigerated (36–46°F / 2–8°C), never frozen. In use, most pens tolerate room temperature for a limited time (Ozempic up to 56 days;…
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Question
# How to store and travel with GLP-1 pens

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
Keep unopened pens refrigerated (36–46°F / 2–8°C), never frozen. In use, most pens tolerate room temperature for a limited time (Ozempic up to 56 days; Wegovy up to 28 days; Zepbound and Mounjaro up to 21 days). Carry them in hand luggage with the prescription label.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Title: Signs of low blood sugar (hypoglycemia)
Summary: Shakiness, sweating, fast heartbeat, hunger, confusion, irritability and blurred vision. Treat with 15 g of fast-acting sugar and recheck in 15 minutes.…
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Question
# Signs of low blood sugar (hypoglycemia)

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
Shakiness, sweating, fast heartbeat, hunger, confusion, irritability and blurred vision. Treat with 15 g of fast-acting sugar and recheck in 15 minutes. Severe lows need [glucagon](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/glucagon/) and emergency help.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

Title: How to use an insulin pen
Summary: Attach a new needle, prime with 2 units, dial the dose, inject at 90 degrees into the stomach or thigh, hold for about 10 seconds, then remove and discard…

Question
# How to use an insulin pen

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

Short answer
Attach a new needle, prime with 2 units, dial the dose, inject at 90 degrees into the stomach or thigh, hold for about 10 seconds, then remove and discard the needle. Rotate sites. Never share pens.
General information based on official labels. Your prescriber or pharmacist can advise on your situation.

# Who qualifies for Wegovy or Zepbound?

# How to choose a GLP-1 telehealth provider

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

URL: https://www.glpatlas.com/glossary/
Title: GLP-1 and Diabetes Glossary
Summary: Plain-English definitions of GLP-1 and diabetes terms: GLP-1, GIP, A1C, basal insulin, titration, half-life, boxed warning, compounded drugs and more.
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Reference
# GLP-1 and diabetes glossary

14 plain-English definitions of the terms you will meet on labels, in trials and at the pharmacy.
✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)

 div" placeholder="Filter terms…" aria-label="Filter glossary terms">

**A1C**: A blood test showing average blood sugar over about 3 months.

**Basal insulin**: Long-acting insulin that covers background needs between meals and overnight.

**BMI**: Body mass index — weight in kilograms divided by height in metres squared.

**Boxed warning**: The FDA's strongest label warning.

**Compounded drug**: A drug mixed by a pharmacy for a patient; not FDA-approved.

**GIP**: Glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide — a gut hormone targeted by tirzepatide.

**GLP-1**: Glucagon-like peptide-1 — a gut hormone that raises insulin, lowers appetite and slows digestion.

**Half-life**: Time for the amount of a drug in the body to fall by half.

**Hypoglycemia**: Low blood sugar.

**MASH**: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis — a form of fatty liver disease.

**MTC**: Medullary thyroid carcinoma — the cancer named in GLP-1 boxed warnings.

**Off-label**: Use of a drug for a purpose not on its approved label.

**Prior authorization**: Insurer approval needed before a drug is covered.

**Titration**: Gradual dose increases to improve tolerance.
No term matches.

Title: Starting Ozempic: Your First 8 Weeks, Week by Week
Summary: What really happens when you start Ozempic: the 0.25 mg starter month, the step to 0.5 mg, side effects to expect, and when to call your doctor.
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Blog · GLP-1 & combinations
# Starting Ozempic: Your First 8 Weeks, Week by Week

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
What really happens when you start Ozempic: the 0.25 mg starter month, the step to 0.5 mg, side effects to expect, and when to call your doctor.
3 min read

Key takeaways
Ozempic starts at 0.25 mg once a week for 4 weeks — a dose meant to let your stomach adjust, not to lower blood sugar much. Most people move to 0.5 mg in week 5. Nausea is most likely in the days after each step up and usually eases.

## Ozempic at a glance

| Generic name | semaglutide |
| Made by | Novo Nordisk |
| Type | GLP-1 receptor agonist |
| Form | Prefilled pen, subcutaneous injection |
| How often | Once weekly |
| United States | FDA-approved (type 2 diabetes). Not approved for weight loss — Wegovy is the semaglutide brand for that. |
| Canada | Approved in Canada. Health Canada has also authorized generic semaglutide injections for type 2 diabetes (Dr. Reddy's, April 28, 2026; Apotex, May 1, 2026). |

[Full Ozempic reference: uses, dosing, side effects ](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/ozempic/)

## Before your first pen

Your prescriber will check your history for medullary thyroid cancer or MEN 2, pancreatitis and eye problems from diabetes, because those change whether semaglutide is right for you. Ask three practical questions before you leave: which day of the week you will inject, what to do with your other diabetes medicines, and how you will check your blood sugar.
If you also take insulin or a sulfonylurea, your dose of those may need lowering — Ozempic plus either can cause low blood sugar.

## Weeks 1–4: the starter dose

The 0.25 mg dose is a warm-up. Do not judge the medicine by your glucose readings this month. Pick a fixed injection day, inject into the stomach, thigh or upper arm, and rotate the spot each week.

- Eat smaller meals and stop as soon as you feel full — the medicine makes fullness arrive earlier.
- Go easy on fatty, fried and very sweet foods in the days after a dose increase.
- Sip water through the day; vomiting or diarrhea can dehydrate you and strain the kidneys.
- Tell your prescriber if nausea lasts — staying on a lower dose longer is a common fix.Ozempic label titration, step by step. Doses go up only as tolerated and as your prescriber decides.

## Weeks 5–8: moving to 0.5 mg

This is the first dose that is expected to improve A1C. Side effects can flare for a few days after the step. If you need more control later, the label allows 1 mg and then 2 mg, each after at least 4 weeks on the dose before.

## Red flags — get medical help

- Severe stomach pain that does not go away, with or without vomiting (possible pancreatitis).
- Pain in the upper right abdomen, fever or yellow skin (gallbladder).
- Signs of dehydration or passing much less urine.
- Sudden changes in vision if you have diabetic eye disease.
Before any surgery or procedure with sedation, tell the team you take Ozempic — food can stay in the stomach longer.

## Making it routine

Set a phone reminder for injection day. An opened pen lasts 56 days at room temperature or in the fridge; keep unopened pens refrigerated and never freeze them. If you miss a dose, take it within 5 days; after that, skip it and keep your usual day.
**⚠ Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).**

## Frequently asked questions

Will I lose weight on Ozempic?

Many people with type 2 diabetes lose some weight, but Ozempic is approved for blood sugar, heart and kidney protection — not for weight loss. Wegovy is the semaglutide brand approved for weight management.Can I change my injection day?

Yes, as long as at least 2 days have passed since your last dose. Then keep the new day every week.Why is my sugar not lower in the first month?

The 0.25 mg starter dose is mainly there to reduce side effects. Glucose lowering is expected from 0.5 mg onward.

Title: Ozempic Tablets: How to Take Them Right Every Morning
Summary: Ozempic tablets (formerly Rybelsus) only work if you take them the right way. The morning routine, the 1.5–4–9 mg steps, and common mistakes.
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Blog · GLP-1 & combinations
# Ozempic Tablets: How to Take Them Right Every Morning

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
Ozempic tablets (formerly Rybelsus) only work if you take them the right way. The morning routine, the 1.5–4–9 mg steps, and common mistakes.
3 min read

Key takeaways
Take Ozempic tablets first thing in the morning on an empty stomach with no more than 4 oz (120 mL) of plain water, then wait at least 30 minutes before eating, drinking or taking other pills. Too much water or food too soon can stop the tablet from being absorbed.

## Ozempic tablets at a glance

| Generic name | oral semaglutide |
| Made by | Novo Nordisk |
| Type | GLP-1 receptor agonist (oral) |
| Form | Tablet |
| How often | Once daily |
| United States | FDA approved the Ozempic name for oral semaglutide 1.5 mg, 4 mg and 9 mg tablets on February 4, 2026; US launch May 4, 2026. Rybelsus 3/7/14 mg remains available during the transition. A 25 mg tablet is under FDA review. |
| Canada | Rybelsus is approved in Canada; check the Health Canada Drug Product Database for the current brand name. |

[Full Ozempic tablets reference: uses, dosing, side effects ](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/ozempic-tablets/)

## Why the rules matter

Semaglutide is a peptide, which the stomach normally breaks down. The tablet contains an absorption enhancer that only works in an empty stomach with very little water. That is why the routine is strict — break it and much less medicine reaches your blood.

## A morning routine that works

- Keep the bottle by your bed with a small marked glass.
- On waking, swallow one tablet whole with up to 4 oz of plain water — no coffee, juice or sparkling water.
- Set a 30-minute timer. Shower, dress, walk the dog.
- Then have breakfast and take your other morning medicines.Ozempic tablets label titration, step by step. Doses go up only as tolerated and as your prescriber decides.

## The new names and doses

In 2026 the FDA approved the Ozempic name for oral semaglutide at 1.5 mg, 4 mg and 9 mg. These replace Rybelsus 3 mg, 7 mg and 14 mg during a transition. Your pharmacist can confirm which strength matches what you took before.

- Days 1–30: 1.5 mg daily.
- Day 31 on: 4 mg daily.
- If more control is needed: 9 mg daily after at least 30 days.

## Common mistakes

- Taking it with a full glass of water or with coffee.
- Eating within the 30 minutes.
- Splitting, crushing or chewing the tablet.
- Moving tablets into a pill organizer — keep them in the original bottle, away from moisture.

## Side effects

The side effects are the same as injectable semaglutide: mostly nausea, diarrhea and constipation, strongest after each dose step. The thyroid C-cell boxed warning also applies.
**⚠ Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).**

## Frequently asked questions

Is a 9 mg tablet the same as a 1 mg Ozempic injection?

No. Doses are not interchangeable between tablets and injections because absorption is very different. Switching is a decision for your prescriber.What if I wake up and forget?

If you have already eaten, skip that day's tablet and take the next one the following morning. Do not take two.Can I take it at night?

The label is built around an empty stomach after an overnight fast, which is why morning dosing is the standard.

Title: Wegovy Week by Week: The 16-Week Dose Climb Explained
Summary: Wegovy takes 16 weeks to reach the 2.4 mg maintenance dose. What each step feels like, how to handle side effects, missed doses and Wegovy HD 7.2 mg.
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Blog · GLP-1 & combinations
# Wegovy Week by Week: The 16-Week Dose Climb Explained

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
Wegovy takes 16 weeks to reach the 2.4 mg maintenance dose. What each step feels like, how to handle side effects, missed doses and Wegovy HD 7.2 mg.
3 min read

Key takeaways
Wegovy climbs every 4 weeks — 0.25, 0.5, 1 and 1.7 mg — to reach the 2.4 mg maintenance dose from week 17. Adults who tolerate 2.4 mg for at least 4 weeks may move to Wegovy HD 7.2 mg. Going slowly is what keeps nausea manageable.

## Wegovy at a glance

| Generic name | semaglutide |
| Made by | Novo Nordisk |
| Type | GLP-1 receptor agonist |
| Form | Single-dose prefilled pen, subcutaneous injection |
| How often | Once weekly |
| United States | FDA-approved. A higher 7.2 mg dose, Wegovy HD, was approved March 19, 2026. |
| Canada | Approved in Canada. Health Canada authorized the first generic semaglutide for weight management on June 29, 2026. |

[Full Wegovy reference: uses, dosing, side effects ](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/wegovy/)

## The schedule at a glance

- Weeks 1–4: 0.25 mg weekly.
- Weeks 5–8: 0.5 mg.
- Weeks 9–12: 1 mg.
- Weeks 13–16: 1.7 mg.
- Week 17 on: 2.4 mg (or 1.7 mg if 2.4 mg is not tolerated).
- Wegovy HD: 7.2 mg for adults after at least 4 weeks on 2.4 mg.
Your prescriber can hold you at a step longer if side effects are hard. That is normal and does not mean the medicine has failed.

## What to expect along the way

Appetite usually drops within the first weeks, but most weight loss happens once you are at or near the maintenance dose. Weigh yourself at the same time of day, once a week, to see the trend rather than daily noise.

- Eat smaller meals and stop as soon as you feel full — the medicine makes fullness arrive earlier.
- Go easy on fatty, fried and very sweet foods in the days after a dose increase.
- Sip water through the day; vomiting or diarrhea can dehydrate you and strain the kidneys.
- Tell your prescriber if nausea lasts — staying on a lower dose longer is a common fix.Wegovy label titration, step by step. Doses go up only as tolerated and as your prescriber decides.

## Protecting muscle and nutrition

Eating less makes every meal count. Build meals around protein and vegetables, keep up fluids, and add strength exercise if you can — it helps you keep muscle while you lose fat. Ask your clinician whether you need a dietitian referral.

## Missed doses

If your next dose is more than 2 days away, take the missed one as soon as possible. If it is less than 2 days away, skip it. If you miss more than 2 weeks, contact your prescriber — you may need to restart at a lower dose.

## Beyond weight

Wegovy is also approved to lower the risk of heart attack and stroke in adults with heart disease and obesity or overweight, and for MASH (fatty liver disease) with moderate-to-advanced fibrosis. Those benefits depend on staying on treatment.
**⚠ Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).**

## Frequently asked questions

Can teenagers use Wegovy?

Yes — it is approved for weight management in children 12 and older with obesity, under specialist care.Can I keep Wegovy out of the fridge?

Pens may be kept at up to 86°F (30°C) for up to 28 days. Never freeze them.What happens if I stop?

Appetite returns over a few weeks and most people regain much of the weight within a year. Plan any stop with your prescriber.

Title: Wegovy Pill Guide: Fasting Rule, Doses and First Months
Summary: The Wegovy pill is daily oral semaglutide for weight loss. How to take it, the 1.5 to 25 mg dose ladder, side effects, and self-pay pricing.
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Blog · GLP-1 & combinations
# Wegovy Pill Guide: Fasting Rule, Doses and First Months

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
The Wegovy pill is daily oral semaglutide for weight loss. How to take it, the 1.5 to 25 mg dose ladder, side effects, and self-pay pricing.
3 min read

Key takeaways
The Wegovy pill is taken once a day on an empty stomach with up to 4 oz of water, followed by a 30-minute wait before food, drinks or other pills. The dose climbs every 30 days — 1.5, 4, 9 mg — to 25 mg daily from day 91.

## Wegovy pill at a glance

| Generic name | oral semaglutide 25 mg |
| Made by | Novo Nordisk |
| Type | GLP-1 receptor agonist (oral) |
| Form | Tablet |
| How often | Once daily |
| United States | FDA-approved December 22, 2025 — the first oral GLP-1 for weight loss. US launch January 2026. |
| Canada | Check the Health Canada Drug Product Database for current status. The European Commission approved it EU-wide in July 2026. |

[Full Wegovy pill reference: uses, dosing, side effects ](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/wegovy-pill/)

## Who it is for

It is approved for weight reduction and long-term maintenance in adults with obesity, or overweight with a weight-related condition. Approved by the FDA on December 22, 2025, it was the first oral GLP-1 for weight loss.

## The fasting rule, made easy

Like Ozempic tablets, the pill needs an empty stomach to be absorbed. Take it on waking with a small glass of plain water, then wait 30 minutes. Keep it in the original container so moisture does not damage the tablets.Wegovy pill label titration, step by step. Doses go up only as tolerated and as your prescriber decides.

## The 90-day ladder

- Days 1–30: 1.5 mg daily.
- Days 31–60: 4 mg.
- Days 61–90: 9 mg.
- Day 91 on: 25 mg maintenance.
The low early doses are about tolerance. Expect the strongest appetite effect once you reach 25 mg.

## Side effects and safety

Nausea, diarrhea, vomiting and constipation are the most common, especially after each step. The pill carries the same thyroid C-cell boxed warning as injectable semaglutide.

- Eat smaller meals and stop as soon as you feel full — the medicine makes fullness arrive earlier.
- Go easy on fatty, fried and very sweet foods in the days after a dose increase.
- Sip water through the day; vomiting or diarrhea can dehydrate you and strain the kidneys.
- Tell your prescriber if nausea lasts — staying on a lower dose longer is a common fix.

## Cost

NovoCare self-pay started at about $149 a month for starter doses and about $299 for higher doses. Promotions change, so check the current price before you fill.
**⚠ Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).**

## Frequently asked questions

Pill or injection — which works better?

In trials the Wegovy pill's average weight loss was comparable to the 2.4 mg injection. The best choice depends on whether you prefer a daily routine or a weekly shot.Can I take my other morning medicines with it?

Not at the same time. Wait at least 30 minutes after the Wegovy pill, then take other oral medicines.How is it different from Foundayo?

Foundayo is a different, non-peptide molecule with no fasting rule. The Wegovy pill is semaglutide and needs the empty-stomach routine.

Title: Starting Mounjaro: What to Expect at Each Dose Step
Summary: A practical guide to Mounjaro (tirzepatide) for type 2 diabetes: the 2.5 mg start, 2.5 mg steps up to 15 mg, side effects, birth control and storage.
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Blog · GLP-1 & combinations
# Starting Mounjaro: What to Expect at Each Dose Step

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
A practical guide to Mounjaro (tirzepatide) for type 2 diabetes: the 2.5 mg start, 2.5 mg steps up to 15 mg, side effects, birth control and storage.
3 min read

Key takeaways
Mounjaro starts at 2.5 mg once a week for 4 weeks, then 5 mg. If more control is needed it rises by 2.5 mg at intervals of 4 weeks or more, to a maximum of 15 mg weekly. It is approved for type 2 diabetes; Zepbound is the tirzepatide brand for weight loss.

## Mounjaro at a glance

| Generic name | tirzepatide |
| Made by | Eli Lilly |
| Type | Dual GIP / GLP-1 receptor agonist |
| Form | Prefilled pen (and vials), subcutaneous injection |
| How often | Once weekly |
| United States | FDA-approved for type 2 diabetes. Not approved for weight loss in the US — Zepbound is the tirzepatide brand for that. |
| Canada | Approved in Canada; check the Drug Product Database for current indications. |

[Full Mounjaro reference: uses, dosing, side effects ](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/mounjaro/)

## How tirzepatide is different

Mounjaro acts on two gut-hormone receptors, GIP and GLP-1, rather than GLP-1 alone. In studies it lowered A1C and weight more on average than semaglutide, although Ozempic has labeled heart and kidney outcome benefits that Mounjaro's US label does not.

## The dose steps

- Weeks 1–4: 2.5 mg (starter, not a treatment dose).
- Week 5 on: 5 mg.
- Then +2.5 mg every 4 weeks or more if needed: 7.5, 10, 12.5 and up to 15 mg.
Many people stay on a middle dose for good. Higher is not automatically better if your sugar is on target.Mounjaro label titration, step by step. Doses go up only as tolerated and as your prescriber decides.

## Birth control: an important detail

Tirzepatide can make birth-control pills less effective, mainly after starting and after each dose increase. The label advises switching to a non-oral method or adding a barrier method for 4 weeks after starting and after each step. Ask your prescriber what fits you.

## Side effects

- Eat smaller meals and stop as soon as you feel full — the medicine makes fullness arrive earlier.
- Go easy on fatty, fried and very sweet foods in the days after a dose increase.
- Sip water through the day; vomiting or diarrhea can dehydrate you and strain the kidneys.
- Tell your prescriber if nausea lasts — staying on a lower dose longer is a common fix.
With insulin or a sulfonylurea, low blood sugar is more likely — your other doses may need adjusting.

## Storage and missed doses

Keep pens refrigerated; a single pen can stay unrefrigerated up to 86°F (30°C) for up to 21 days. If you miss a dose, take it within 4 days (96 hours); after that, skip it and keep your usual day.
**⚠ Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).**

## Frequently asked questions

Can Mounjaro be prescribed for weight loss?

In the US, Mounjaro is approved for type 2 diabetes. The same molecule is approved for weight management as Zepbound.Can I inject at any time of day?

Yes — once weekly, any time of day, with or without food. Keep the same day each week.How long does tirzepatide stay in the body?

Its half-life is about 5 days, so it takes roughly 25–30 days to clear after the last dose.

Title: Zepbound for Weight Loss: A Practical Starter Guide

Blog · GLP-1 & combinations
# Zepbound for Weight Loss: A Practical Starter Guide

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
Starting Zepbound (tirzepatide): dose steps from 2.5 to 15 mg, pens vs vials, sleep apnea use, self-pay prices on LillyDirect and tips for side effects.
3 min read

Key takeaways
Zepbound starts at 2.5 mg weekly for 4 weeks, then 5 mg, rising by 2.5 mg every 4 weeks if needed. Maintenance is 5, 10 or 15 mg (10 or 15 mg for sleep apnea). It is available as pens or single-dose vials, including self-pay vials through LillyDirect.

## Zepbound at a glance

| Generic name | tirzepatide |
| Made by | Eli Lilly |
| Type | Dual GIP / GLP-1 receptor agonist |
| Form | Prefilled pen or single-dose vial, subcutaneous injection |
| How often | Once weekly |
| United States | FDA-approved. |
| Canada | The Zepbound name is US-specific; in Canada tirzepatide is marketed as Mounjaro. Check the Drug Product Database. |

[Full Zepbound reference: uses, dosing, side effects ](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/zepbound/)

## Who it is approved for

Adults with obesity, or overweight with a weight-related condition, for weight reduction and long-term maintenance — and adults with obesity and moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea.

## Pens or vials?

Pens are simplest: a fixed dose with a hidden needle. Vials are drawn up with a syringe and are the main self-pay option on LillyDirect, where reported prices have been about $299 a month for 2.5 mg, $399 for 5 mg and $449 for higher doses. Ask your pharmacist to show you how to draw up a vial dose if you choose them.Zepbound label titration, step by step. Doses go up only as tolerated and as your prescriber decides.

## The first three months

Weeks 1–4 at 2.5 mg are about getting used to the medicine. From 5 mg, appetite usually drops clearly. Your prescriber decides whether and when to go higher.

- Eat smaller meals and stop as soon as you feel full — the medicine makes fullness arrive earlier.
- Go easy on fatty, fried and very sweet foods in the days after a dose increase.
- Sip water through the day; vomiting or diarrhea can dehydrate you and strain the kidneys.
- Tell your prescriber if nausea lasts — staying on a lower dose longer is a common fix.

## Birth control and other medicines

Like Mounjaro, Zepbound can reduce how well birth-control pills work, especially for 4 weeks after starting and after each dose increase. Use a non-oral or added barrier method as your prescriber advises.

## Keeping results

Weight tends to return after stopping. Think of Zepbound as long-term treatment and build habits — protein-forward meals, strength exercise, sleep — that support it.
**⚠ Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).**

## Frequently asked questions

Is Zepbound available in Canada?

The Zepbound name is US-specific. In Canada, tirzepatide is marketed as Mounjaro; check the Drug Product Database for indications.Can Zepbound stay out of the fridge?

Pens and vials may be kept unrefrigerated up to 86°F (30°C) for up to 21 days.What if I miss a dose?

Take it within 4 days. If more than 4 days have passed, skip it and take the next dose on your regular day.

Title: Foundayo: Living With the No-Fasting Weight-Loss Pill
Summary: Foundayo (orforglipron) is a daily weight-loss pill with no fasting rule. The six-step dose ladder, results, side effects and LillyDirect pricing.
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Blog · GLP-1 & combinations
# Foundayo: Living With the No-Fasting Weight-Loss Pill

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
Foundayo (orforglipron) is a daily weight-loss pill with no fasting rule. The six-step dose ladder, results, side effects and LillyDirect pricing.
3 min read

Key takeaways
Foundayo is a once-daily tablet you can take at any time, with or without food or water. It starts at 0.8 mg and climbs every 30 days to a maintenance dose of 5.5 mg or more, up to 17.2 mg. In trials the highest dose produced about 12% average weight loss at 72 weeks.

## Foundayo at a glance

| Generic name | orforglipron |
| Made by | Eli Lilly |
| Type | Small-molecule (non-peptide) oral GLP-1 receptor agonist |
| Form | Tablet |
| How often | Once daily |
| United States | FDA-approved April 1, 2026. Not approved for type 2 diabetes in the US (Lilly has filed in many countries). |
| Canada | Check the Health Canada Drug Product Database for current status. |

[Full Foundayo reference: uses, dosing, side effects ](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/foundayo/)

## What makes it different

Orforglipron is a small molecule, not a peptide. That is why it survives digestion without the strict empty-stomach routine semaglutide tablets need. The FDA approved it for weight management on April 1, 2026.

## The dose ladder

- Days 1–30: 0.8 mg.
- Days 31–60: 2.5 mg.
- Days 61–90: 5.5 mg — the lowest maintenance dose.
- If needed: 9 mg, 14.5 mg, then 17.2 mg, each after at least 30 days.
If you take a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor (some antifungals and antibiotics, for example), the maximum is 9 mg. Give your pharmacist a full medicine list.Foundayo label titration, step by step. Doses go up only as tolerated and as your prescriber decides.

## Making it a habit

Because timing is flexible, tie it to something you already do daily — brushing your teeth or your morning coffee. Keep tablets at room temperature in the original container.

## Side effects

Gastrointestinal effects are the most common, as with other GLP-1 medicines. The thyroid C-cell boxed warning applies.

- Eat smaller meals and stop as soon as you feel full — the medicine makes fullness arrive earlier.
- Go easy on fatty, fried and very sweet foods in the days after a dose increase.
- Sip water through the day; vomiting or diarrhea can dehydrate you and strain the kidneys.
- Tell your prescriber if nausea lasts — staying on a lower dose longer is a common fix.

## Cost

LillyDirect self-pay launched at $149 a month for 0.8 mg, $199 for 2.5 mg and $299 for higher doses. With commercial coverage, a savings card may bring it to $25 a month.
**⚠ Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).**

## Frequently asked questions

Is Foundayo approved for diabetes?

Not in the US as of October 2026; it is approved for weight management.Foundayo or the Wegovy pill?

The Wegovy pill showed larger average weight loss in trials; Foundayo is easier to take because it has no fasting rule.Do I need to take it at the same time each day?

There is no fasting or timing rule, but a consistent time helps you remember.

Blog · GLP-1 & combinations
# Victoza and Generic Liraglutide: A Daily-Pen Guide

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
Using Victoza or generic liraglutide for type 2 diabetes: the 0.6 to 1.8 mg steps, daily pen tips, children 10+, and why the generic can save money.
3 min read

Key takeaways
Victoza is a once-daily liraglutide pen for type 2 diabetes. You start at 0.6 mg for a week, move to 1.2 mg, and may go to 1.8 mg. A generic liraglutide equivalent is available in the US, usually at a much lower price than weekly GLP-1 brands.

## Victoza at a glance

| Generic name | liraglutide |
| Made by | Novo Nordisk; generics available |
| Type | GLP-1 receptor agonist |
| Form | Prefilled multi-dose pen |
| How often | Once daily |
| United States | FDA-approved; generic liraglutide (Victoza equivalent) is available. |
| Canada | Approved in Canada. |

[Full Victoza reference: uses, dosing, side effects ](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/victoza/)

## Why choose a daily GLP-1?

Weekly medicines are more convenient, but liraglutide has a long track record, a labeled heart benefit for adults with type 2 diabetes and heart disease, approval for children 10 and older, and — now — generic pricing.

## Using a multi-dose pen

- Attach a new needle for each injection.
- Dial the dose your prescriber set (0.6, 1.2 or 1.8 mg).
- Inject under the skin of the stomach, thigh or upper arm — any time of day, with or without meals.
- Remove and discard the needle in a sharps container.Victoza label titration, step by step. Doses go up only as tolerated and as your prescriber decides.

## Dose steps

- Week 1: 0.6 mg daily (starter only).
- Week 2 on: 1.2 mg daily.
- If needed: 1.8 mg daily.

## Side effects

- Eat smaller meals and stop as soon as you feel full — the medicine makes fullness arrive earlier.
- Go easy on fatty, fried and very sweet foods in the days after a dose increase.
- Sip water through the day; vomiting or diarrhea can dehydrate you and strain the kidneys.
- Tell your prescriber if nausea lasts — staying on a lower dose longer is a common fix.

## Storage

Refrigerate pens before first use. Once in use, a pen lasts 30 days at room temperature or in the fridge.
**⚠ Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).**

## Frequently asked questions

Is generic liraglutide the same as Victoza?

The FDA-approved generic is equivalent to Victoza. Your pharmacist can substitute it where allowed.Victoza or Saxenda?

Both are liraglutide. Victoza (up to 1.8 mg) is for type 2 diabetes; Saxenda (3 mg) is for weight management.Can I take it at a different time each day?

Liraglutide can be taken at any time, but a regular time helps you avoid missed doses.

Title: Saxenda in 5 Weeks: The Daily Liraglutide Ramp-Up
Summary: Saxenda (liraglutide 3 mg) for weight loss: the weekly 0.6 mg steps to 3 mg, tips for daily injections, generic savings and checking results at 16 weeks.
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Blog · GLP-1 & combinations
# Saxenda in 5 Weeks: The Daily Liraglutide Ramp-Up

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
Saxenda (liraglutide 3 mg) for weight loss: the weekly 0.6 mg steps to 3 mg, tips for daily injections, generic savings and checking results at 16 weeks.
3 min read

Key takeaways
Saxenda adds 0.6 mg each week — 0.6, 1.2, 1.8, 2.4 — to reach the 3 mg daily maintenance dose in week 5. Since Teva's generic launched in August 2025, it can be the lowest-cost GLP-1 for weight management without insurance.

## Saxenda at a glance

| Generic name | liraglutide |
| Made by | Novo Nordisk; generic by Teva |
| Type | GLP-1 receptor agonist |
| Form | Prefilled multi-dose pen |
| How often | Once daily |
| United States | FDA-approved. Teva launched the first generic of Saxenda in August 2025. |
| Canada | Approved in Canada. |

[Full Saxenda reference: uses, dosing, side effects ](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/saxenda/)

## Who it suits

Adults and adolescents 12 and older with obesity, and adults with overweight plus a weight-related condition. It needs a daily injection and average results are smaller than weekly semaglutide or tirzepatide, but price and familiarity make it a practical choice for many.

## The five-week ramp

- Week 1: 0.6 mg daily.
- Week 2: 1.2 mg.
- Week 3: 1.8 mg.
- Week 4: 2.4 mg.
- Week 5 on: 3 mg maintenance.
If a step causes strong nausea, your prescriber may hold you there an extra week.Saxenda label titration, step by step. Doses go up only as tolerated and as your prescriber decides.

## Daily-injection tips

- Inject at the same time each day — linking it to a meal or bedtime helps.
- Use a new needle each time and rotate sites.
- Keep a spare needle pack in your bag.

- Eat smaller meals and stop as soon as you feel full — the medicine makes fullness arrive earlier.
- Go easy on fatty, fried and very sweet foods in the days after a dose increase.
- Sip water through the day; vomiting or diarrhea can dehydrate you and strain the kidneys.
- Tell your prescriber if nausea lasts — staying on a lower dose longer is a common fix.

## Reviewing progress

Prescribers usually review your weight about 16 weeks after starting. If the medicine is not helping enough, the label advises stopping rather than continuing indefinitely — talk through other options.

## Storage

Refrigerate before first use; once in use, a pen lasts 30 days at room temperature or in the fridge.
**⚠ Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).**

## Frequently asked questions

Is generic Saxenda as effective?

The generic contains the same active ingredient at the same dose and is approved as equivalent.Can I switch from Saxenda to Wegovy?

Yes, under your prescriber's direction — they will set the starting dose of the new medicine.Do I need to eat when I inject?

No. Saxenda can be injected at any time, independent of meals.

Title: Trulicity Guide: Weekly Pen, Dose Steps and Tips
Summary: Trulicity (dulaglutide) for type 2 diabetes: how the single-dose pen works, the 0.75 to 4.5 mg steps, missed doses, storage and cost options.
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Blog · GLP-1 & combinations
# Trulicity Guide: Weekly Pen, Dose Steps and Tips

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
Trulicity (dulaglutide) for type 2 diabetes: how the single-dose pen works, the 0.75 to 4.5 mg steps, missed doses, storage and cost options.
3 min read

Key takeaways
Trulicity is a once-weekly dulaglutide pen for type 2 diabetes. It starts at 0.75 mg and can rise to 1.5, 3 and 4.5 mg, each after at least 4 weeks. The single-dose pen has a hidden, pre-attached needle, which many first-time injectors find easy.

## Trulicity at a glance

| Generic name | dulaglutide |
| Made by | Eli Lilly |
| Type | GLP-1 receptor agonist |
| Form | Single-dose pen |
| How often | Once weekly |
| United States | FDA-approved. |
| Canada | Approved in Canada. |

[Full Trulicity reference: uses, dosing, side effects ](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/trulicity/)

## Why people like the pen

There is nothing to dial or attach. You uncap the pen, place it flat on the skin, unlock and press. It is a good fit if needle anxiety is a concern.

## Dose steps

- Start: 0.75 mg weekly.
- If needed: 1.5 mg, then 3 mg, then 4.5 mg, each after at least 4 weeks.
- Maximum: 4.5 mg weekly.Trulicity label titration, step by step. Doses go up only as tolerated and as your prescriber decides.

## Living with Trulicity

- Eat smaller meals and stop as soon as you feel full — the medicine makes fullness arrive earlier.
- Go easy on fatty, fried and very sweet foods in the days after a dose increase.
- Sip water through the day; vomiting or diarrhea can dehydrate you and strain the kidneys.
- Tell your prescriber if nausea lasts — staying on a lower dose longer is a common fix.
Trulicity is also approved to lower cardiovascular risk in adults with type 2 diabetes, and for children 10 and older with type 2 diabetes.

## Missed doses

Take a missed dose if there are at least 3 days (72 hours) until the next scheduled one. Otherwise skip it and keep your schedule.

## Storage and cost

Refrigerate pens; each can be kept at room temperature for up to 14 days. Lilly has offered Trulicity through LillyDirect at a discount off list price — compare with your insurance copay.
**⚠ Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).**

## Frequently asked questions

Can I reuse a Trulicity pen?

No. Each pen delivers one dose and is then discarded in a sharps container.Can I take Trulicity with insulin?

Yes, if your prescriber decides so, but insulin doses may need lowering to avoid low blood sugar.Is Trulicity used for weight loss?

It is approved for type 2 diabetes. Some weight loss can occur, but it is not a weight-management medicine.

Title: Byetta vs Bydureon BCise: Using Exenatide in 2026
Summary: Exenatide twice daily (Byetta) vs once weekly (Bydureon BCise): dosing, how to use each pen, availability limits in the US, and alternatives to ask about.
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Blog · GLP-1 & combinations
# Byetta vs Bydureon BCise: Using Exenatide in 2026

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
Exenatide twice daily (Byetta) vs once weekly (Bydureon BCise): dosing, how to use each pen, availability limits in the US, and alternatives to ask about.
3 min read

Key takeaways
Exenatide was the first GLP-1 medicine. Byetta is injected twice daily before meals; Bydureon BCise once a week. Both are now hard to find in the US, so check supply with your pharmacist before relying on them.

## Exenatide at a glance

| Generic name | exenatide |
| Made by | AstraZeneca |
| Type | GLP-1 receptor agonist |
| Form | Pen injection |
| How often | Twice daily (Byetta) or once weekly (Bydureon BCise) |
| United States | Largely withdrawn from the US market; availability is limited. Ask a pharmacist before relying on supply. |
| Canada | Check the Drug Product Database for current marketing status. |

[Full Exenatide reference: uses, dosing, side effects ](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/byetta-bydureon/)

## Two very different schedules

- **Byetta:** 5 mcg twice daily within 60 minutes before the morning and evening meals; may increase to 10 mcg after a month.
- **Bydureon BCise:** 2 mg once weekly, same day each week, with or without meals.

## Using Bydureon BCise

The autoinjector holds an extended-release suspension that must be mixed well. Follow the leaflet's instructions to shake it hard before injecting, then inject straight away. Uneven mixing means an incomplete dose.The four main actions of GLP-1 receptor agonists, as described on their labels.

## Safety notes

Bydureon BCise carries the thyroid C-cell tumor boxed warning; twice-daily Byetta does not. Both can cause nausea, and both raise the risk of low blood sugar with insulin or a sulfonylurea.

## If you cannot get it

Supply has been limited as the products were largely withdrawn from the US market. If your pharmacy cannot fill it, ask your prescriber about switching to another GLP-1 such as dulaglutide, semaglutide or generic liraglutide — never stop without a plan for your blood sugar.
**⚠ Bydureon BCise carries the thyroid C-cell tumor boxed warning; twice-daily Byetta does not.**

## Frequently asked questions

Is Byetta still sold?

Availability in the US is limited. Ask your pharmacist before relying on supply, and check the Drug Product Database in Canada.Can Byetta be taken after meals?

No — it is meant to be injected within 60 minutes before meals. Skip a dose rather than taking it after eating.Which is stronger, Byetta or Bydureon?

They use different schedules and formulations; your prescriber chooses based on your glucose pattern and routine.

Title: Soliqua 100/33: How the Insulin–GLP-1 Combo Works
Summary: Soliqua combines insulin glargine and lixisenatide in one daily pen. Who it suits, how dosing in units works, timing before breakfast, and low-sugar safety.
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Blog · GLP-1 & combinations
# Soliqua 100/33: How the Insulin–GLP-1 Combo Works

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
Soliqua combines insulin glargine and lixisenatide in one daily pen. Who it suits, how dosing in units works, timing before breakfast, and low-sugar safety.
3 min read

Key takeaways
Soliqua 100/33 puts long-acting insulin glargine and the GLP-1 lixisenatide in one pen. You inject it once a day within the hour before your first meal. The dose is set in units by your prescriber — each unit gives both medicines.

## Soliqua at a glance

| Generic name | insulin glargine + lixisenatide |
| Made by | Sanofi |
| Type | Basal insulin + GLP-1 receptor agonist combination |
| Form | Prefilled pen |
| How often | Once daily |
| United States | FDA-approved. Standalone lixisenatide (Adlyxin) has been discontinued; lixisenatide remains available inside Soliqua. |
| Canada | Check the Drug Product Database. |

[Full Soliqua reference: uses, dosing, side effects ](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/soliqua/)

## Why combine them

Basal insulin controls fasting sugar; lixisenatide mainly blunts the rise after meals. Combining them can mean one injection instead of two and sometimes a lower insulin dose than insulin alone.

## How dosing works

Your prescriber chooses a starting dose in units based on your previous treatment and adjusts it from your fasting glucose. Because the ratio is fixed, you cannot change one ingredient without the other — that is why only your care team should change the dose.The four main actions of GLP-1 receptor agonists, as described on their labels.

## Daily routine

- Inject within 1 hour before the first meal of the day.
- Attach a new needle and prime the pen as the leaflet shows.
- Rotate injection sites to prevent skin lumps.

## Low blood sugar

Soliqua contains insulin, so hypoglycemia is possible. Know the signs — shaking, sweating, confusion — and carry fast sugar. A common rule is 15 g of fast-acting carbohydrate, then recheck in 15 minutes.

## Storage and supply

Refrigerate unused pens; once in use, keep at room temperature for up to 28 days. Standalone lixisenatide (Adlyxin) is discontinued, but it remains available inside Soliqua.

## Frequently asked questions

Can I take Soliqua with another GLP-1?

No. It already contains a GLP-1 receptor agonist; it should not be combined with another.What if I miss the pre-breakfast dose?

Follow your prescriber's instructions; the label advises taking the next dose at the usual time rather than doubling.Is Soliqua for type 1 diabetes?

No. It is approved for adults with type 2 diabetes.

Title: Xultophy 100/3.6: A Guide to the Daily Combo Pen
Summary: Xultophy combines insulin degludec and liraglutide in one daily pen. How the fixed ratio works, injection timing, side effects and storage.

Blog · GLP-1 & combinations
# Xultophy 100/3.6: A Guide to the Daily Combo Pen

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
Xultophy combines insulin degludec and liraglutide in one daily pen. How the fixed ratio works, injection timing, side effects and storage.
3 min read

Key takeaways
Xultophy 100/3.6 contains insulin degludec and liraglutide in a fixed ratio. You inject it once a day at the same time, with or without food. Your prescriber sets and adjusts the dose in units, and the label caps the daily dose because each unit also delivers liraglutide.

## Xultophy at a glance

| Generic name | insulin degludec + liraglutide |
| Made by | Novo Nordisk |
| Type | Basal insulin + GLP-1 receptor agonist combination |
| Form | Prefilled pen |
| How often | Once daily |
| United States | FDA-approved. |
| Canada | Check the Drug Product Database. |

[Full Xultophy reference: uses, dosing, side effects ](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/xultophy/)

## What is in the pen

Each mL holds 100 units of degludec, an ultra-long-acting basal insulin, and 3.6 mg of liraglutide, the GLP-1 in Victoza. Together they target fasting and after-meal sugar with one injection.

## Starting and adjusting

The starting dose depends on what you used before. Adjustments are usually made every few days from fasting readings, following a plan from your care team. Keep a simple log of fasting glucose and doses to bring to appointments.The four main actions of GLP-1 receptor agonists, as described on their labels.

## Side effects

Expect possible nausea in the first weeks from the liraglutide part, and the risk of low blood sugar from the insulin part. Xultophy carries the thyroid C-cell boxed warning.

- Eat smaller meals and stop as soon as you feel full — the medicine makes fullness arrive earlier.
- Go easy on fatty, fried and very sweet foods in the days after a dose increase.
- Sip water through the day; vomiting or diarrhea can dehydrate you and strain the kidneys.
- Tell your prescriber if nausea lasts — staying on a lower dose longer is a common fix.

## Storage

Refrigerate unused pens. Once in use, a pen lasts up to 21 days at room temperature or in the fridge.
**⚠ Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).**

## Frequently asked questions

Can Xultophy replace my separate insulin and GLP-1?

That is often the goal, but switching must be planned by your prescriber, who will set a new starting dose.Does the time of day matter?

Inject at the same time each day; it can be taken with or without food.Can I use it with another GLP-1?

No — it already contains liraglutide.

Title: Mealtime Insulin Lispro: Humalog, Admelog, Lyumjev
Summary: How to time insulin lispro with meals — Humalog and Admelog vs faster Lyumjev — plus pen technique, pump use, low-sugar safety and $35 cost programs.
Last reviewed: 2026-10-20

Blog · Insulin
# Mealtime Insulin Lispro: Humalog, Admelog, Lyumjev

✓Last reviewed October 20, 2026 · Written by [Dr. George Grunberger](https://www.glpatlas.com/about/#editor) · Medical review: pending — clinician review in progress · [How we review](https://www.glpatlas.com/editorial-policy/)
How to time insulin lispro with meals — Humalog and Admelog vs faster Lyumjev — plus pen technique, pump use, low-sugar safety and $35 cost programs.
3 min read

Key takeaways
Insulin lispro is a rapid-acting mealtime insulin. Humalog and Admelog are taken within 15 minutes before or right after a meal; Lyumjev, a faster formulation, at the start of a meal or within 20 minutes after starting. Your dose in units is always set individually.

## Insulin lispro at a glance

| Generic name | insulin lispro |
| Made by | Eli Lilly; Sanofi (Admelog) |
| Type | Rapid-acting (mealtime) insulin |
| Form | Vials, pens, cartridges |
| How often | With meals |
| United States | FDA-approved; lower-cost unbranded lispro is available. |
| Canada | Available in Canada. |

[Full Insulin lispro reference: uses, dosing, side effects ](https://www.glpatlas.com/drugs/insulin-lispro/)

## Brands and why timing differs

Humalog (Lilly) and Admelog (Sanofi) are the same molecule at the same speed. Lyumjev contains added ingredients that speed absorption, so it is taken closer to eating. Lower-cost unbranded lispro is also available in the US.

## Matching insulin to meals

Your care team may give you a fixed dose per meal or teach you to adjust by carbohydrate and current glucose. Write the plan down, including what to do when you skip a meal — usually, no meal means no mealtime insulin.Typical time-action profiles from product labels (darker band = peak). Your response can differ — follow your own plan.

## Pen technique

- Check the label and the insulin's appearance before every dose.
- Attach a new needle and do the safety (prime) shot the leaflet describes.
- Inject under the skin and hold the needle in for the time the leaflet says.
- Rotate sites within an area to avoid lumpy skin (lipohypertrophy), which slows absorption.
- Never share pens, even with a new needle.

## Pumps

Lispro is widely used in insulin pumps. If you use one, ask which formulation your pump is approved for and how often to change the reservoir.

## Low blood sugar

**Know your low-sugar plan.** Signs include shaking, sweating, a fast heartbeat, hunger, confusion and irritability. A common approach is the rule of 15: take 15 g of fast-acting carbohydrate (glucose tablets, juice or regular soda), recheck after 15 minutes, and repeat if still low. Make sure someone close to you knows how to use rescue glucagon.

## Storage and cost

Keep unopened insulin in the fridge; an in-use pen or vial lasts up to 28 days at room temperature.
In the US, Medicare caps insulin out-of-pocket costs at $35 a month, and manufacturers run $35 programs for many people with commercial insurance or none. Check eligibility before paying list price.

## Frequently asked questions

Can I inject lispro after eating?

Humalog and Admelog can be taken right after a meal, and Lyumjev within 20 minutes after starting. Follow the plan your clinician gives you.Is Humalog the same as Admelog?

Both are insulin lispro with the same action profile, from different manufacturers.Do I need lispro if I use basal insulin?

It depends on your diabetes type and meals. Many people with type 1 need both; many with type 2 start with basal only.
